verdict.rationale: Supermemory MCP explicitly gives every MCP-compatible assistant a shared memory layer so different tools access the same authorized context, with documented setup for coding agents/CLI/skill and container-tag scoping per user; this directly matches the story of Claude/ChatGPT/Cursor sharing memory. missing for 10: no independent hands-on confirmation that Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor specifically are simultaneously connected and sharing memory in practice, and MCP endpoint noted as unauthenticated which raises minor security caveats.
